newsitem.title: USA: Archer Daniels to plead guilty in case-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Archer Daniels to plead guilty in case-WSJ.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co is expected to agree to plead guilty to two criminal charges and pay a total of $100 million in fines following a federal investigation into price fixing in the sale of agricultural products, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.

The newpaper said the company had tentatively decided to agree to the pleas regarding the sale of two corn-derived products. It could formally agree to it on Monday, it added, citing people close to the case.
Although the company had not signed the plea agreement over the weekend, both sides had apparently agreed to it, the newspaper said.
It described the fines as the largest in a criminal antitrust case.
